title: How a Humidifier Works in 60 Seconds 💧🌫️ #shorts
description:
An ultrasonic humidifier has no heater at all. A small ceramic disc under the water vibrates more than a million times a second, shaking the surface into a cool fog of tiny droplets that a fan blows into the room. A sensor stops it once the air is comfortable. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#humidifier #ultrasonic #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: This cool mist is made by a disc shaking over a *million times a second*.

steps.label: Tank
steps.text: Water flows from the *tank* into a shallow basin.

steps.label: Disc
steps.text: Under it sits a *piezo disc*, a ceramic that flexes when electricity hits it.

steps.label: Mist
steps.text: Its vibrations rip the surface into *tiny droplets*, a cold fog with no heat.

steps.label: Fan
steps.text: A small *fan* pushes the fog up the nozzle and into the room.

steps.label: Sensor
steps.text: A *humidity sensor* stops it around 30 to 50 percent, the comfortable range.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Shake, *mist*, blow. Follow Inside 60 for more.
